## Description of Changes
Please include a concise summary of the changes and the motivation or context behind them.

Fixes #(issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Build / CI pipeline enhancement

## Quality & Testing Checklist
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally by running `python main.py`.
- [ ] I have run the automated test suite with `pytest -v` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified that no regressions or memory leaks were introduced.
- [ ] I have adhered to existing code conventions, clean typing, and zero-emoji documentation rules.
- [ ] I understand that final review and merge authority belongs exclusively to the Lead Developer.

## Visual Verification (Screenshots / Recordings)
If this change affects the user interface, please attach before/after screenshots or a short recording.
